bullets.text: Evolving AI Governance - Regulators are prioritising accountability and evidence in AI governance for financial institutions.
Crypto Travel Rule Impact - The Travel Rule enhances transparency in digital asset transfers, aligning them with traditional finance.
Future of UK Retail Disclosure - The FCA's CCI regime shifts to a consumer-focused investment information framework by 2027.
Capco's Charity Partnership - Capco partners with KidsOut to support children facing challenges through community initiatives.
Canada Payment Fraud Insights - A significant percentage of Canadians express concerns over payment fraud and deep fake technology.
